subject: Pilot access extension request — procurement hold
thread_text:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@novamed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access question

Hi Tessa —

Quick status update from our side: procurement has flagged the PO for additional vendor validation and the sign-off is likely delayed by 6–8 business days. We’re worried the pilot token budget will hit zero before procurement finishes.

Is there any way Redwood can keep the environment live for another week (or provide a small top-up) so our engineers can finish integration tests? If not, we’ll need to pause the clock which will set us back on the rollout timeline.

I attached a one-page PO status note from our procurement team for context (NovaMed_PO_status.pdf).

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Ellis
Head of Integrations, NovaMed

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@novamed.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access question

Tom — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the PO note.

We can do a short, one-week soft-landing to keep the workspace live while procurement completes validation. Proposal: 7 days of extended pilot access + a 1,000-token credit pool to cover integration smoke tests. This is a one-time make-good tied to RNW-4782; if procurement clears earlier we can reconcile usage.

Before I issue this, two quick asks:
- David: can finance approve the 1,000-token operational credit on the RNW-4782 deal?
- Camila: we’ll need CS to record the extension in HubSpot and note the start/end dates. HubSpot link here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4782

If you confirm, I’ll route approval and get it live today.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0183

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 14:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access question

Tessa / Tom —

I reviewed the RNW-4782 request and approve a one-week extension with the 1,000-token credit. Please note: this credit is operational (not billable) and tied to the account for tracking; we’ll reconcile if procurement finalizes the PO sooner than expected. I’m attaching a brief approval note for records (approval_note.pdf).

Camila — can you log the extension in HubSpot and update the deal timeline? Start: 2026-07-28 10:30 PDT, End: 2026-08-04 10:30 PDT.

Tom — you should see the tokens land in the account within the hour. Let us know if you need a temporary increase to concurrency or anything else on the infra side.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

This is perfect — thank you all for the quick turnaround.

We confirm acceptance of the one-week extension and the 1,000-token top-up. Camila, I’ll reply to the HubSpot note with the procurement contact info so it’s visible.

Appreciate the flexibility — this keeps our integration schedule on track.

Best,
Tom
